messages.content:
<document id=DOC_availability_week>
Measured availability: 99.1 percent.
Incidents this week: one lasting 12 minutes, one lasting 41 minutes.
</document>

Using the readings below, produce the weekly availability summary.

Two gates apply. Availability must be at or above 99.5 percent, and no
single incident may exceed 60 minutes. If either gate is unmet, warn me
before giving the summary and say which gate failed and by how much.

response.text:
Warning: One or more availability gates were not met this week.

- Gate 1 (Availability ≥ 99.5%): **Failed**. Actual measured availability was 99.1%, which is **0.4% below** the required threshold.
- Gate 2 (No single incident > 60 minutes): **Passed**. The longest incident lasted 41 minutes, which is within the 60-minute limit.

**Summary:**  
Availability this week was 99.1 percent, with two incidents reported: one lasting 12 minutes and another lasting 41 minutes. Please note that weekly availability was below the required threshold.
